non_overlap_decision: Do not restore, delete, or merge the missing validator blindly while current main is moving and singleton execution gates remain nonterminal. Treat the G3 source receipt as non-current at exact-source scope until a single canonical validator path is selected and source-bound on current main.
next_exact_gate: After re-entering current main and consuming terminal results for singleton gates #2121/#2122, select one canonical workpackage-state validator path, bind its exact current source identity into a successor F2-WP-002 claim/receipt, remove or explicitly retire the other path without weakening invariants, and only then execute one authorized repository-bound deterministic validation run. No runtime or terminal generation credit before that receipt exists.
